svg.title: Folder layout for BlackVue clip categories
svg.desc: Clips are stored under a base folder. The default is internal storage blackvue. Category folders are eventos, parking, normal, geocerca, and conductor, with one folder per day. Missing parents and category folders are created before download. Camera filenames are rewritten into a readable Spanish name.
